title: Cost-flow attribution = competitive moat; formula settled
summary: Strategic: exact token-cost attribution per merged result is a major competitive advantage — the orchestrator owns both the task graph (deps + context edges) and the session transcripts (per-call token usage), so it can price every result and name every dead branch; hosted competitors see neither. Formula (conservation property — every token counted exactly once): T(n) = own_tokens(n) + Σ inherited shares; node n passes T(n)·w/W(n) along each outgoing edge (W(n)=total outgoing weight); compute in topo order. Merged node = sink: claims accumulated T, outgoing edges carry 0 afterward (reuse is free/amortized). Only count edges consumed before the merge. Base weights: blocking=1.0, context=0.5, tunable/learnable later. Autonomy score = Σ merged results' T ÷ human-typed tokens; waste = T trapped in terminal non-merged nodes. Relates to note-mq875f7iit6 (autonomy score definition + first measurement 220×).
